name: @weavetab/plugin-auth
description: Zero-Leak Enterprise Session & Cookie Vault for Weavetab. Securely capture and inject encrypted browser sessions without exposing credentials to agent context.

cdp.reason: Extracts and restores cookies and origin storage directly across the local CDP socket.

fs.reason: Stores and reads encrypted AES-256-GCM session vault profiles under ~/.weavetab/vault/.

tools.reason: Registers the plugin_auth_capture, plugin_auth_inject, plugin_auth_list, and plugin_auth_delete MCP tools.

tools.name: plugin_auth_capture
tools.description: Snapshots active session cookies and origin storage from the active tab or target URL, encrypts them locally with AES-256-GCM, and stores them in the local vault. Raw credentials are never leaked to LLM context.

service.description: Identifier name for this session profile (e.g. 'github', 'google', 'stripe'). Inferred from domain if omitted.

url.description: Explicit URL to capture session cookies for. When omitted, inferred from the active browser tab.

include_storage.description: Whether to capture localStorage alongside cookies (default true).

tools.name: plugin_auth_inject
tools.description: Decrypts a local session vault profile and injects cookies and origin storage directly into the active browser tab via CDP. Zero credentials enter agent prompt context.

service.description: The service identifier or domain of the stored vault profile to inject (e.g. 'github').

url.description: Optional destination URL to navigate to after injection. Defaults to profile origin.

navigate.description: Whether to navigate to the target URL after injection so the authenticated view renders (default true).

tools.name: plugin_auth_list
tools.description: Lists all captured session profiles in the local vault with metadata (service, domain, cookie count, captured timestamp). Never reveals raw tokens or values.

tools.name: plugin_auth_delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes an encrypted session profile from the local vault.

service.description: Identifier of the profile to delete.
